description: This apworld is utilizing the manual template, but is not a manual. Much of this is a POC for using the manual template as a JsonWorld style implementation

0.1.0.description:
**this release currently conflicts with the manual client and may prevent you from opening a manual client altogether if this is installed**

Currently working features

Goal -recieve a certain number of "dragon banner"items. There are 50 in the pool, you can choose how many to receive before the game goals.
Progressive troop tiers - you cannot upgrade troops past the amount of progressive troop tiers you've received for that culture
QuestSanity with options to remove certain types of quests
TroopSanity - each time you upgrade to a new unit type is a location
CraftSanity - crafting one of each type of item and each tier is a check (tier is configurable between 1-6)
SkillSanity - every 25 of each skill is a check. Configurable up to 300
TournamentSanity - Completion of tournaments in each city are locations
FoodSanity - completing a day with X food morale bonus from having a variety of food.
Items - all lords +5 relations, varying amount of denars, varying amounts of renown, experience in specific skills. Butter.
Blocking items - tournament passes are required to access tournaments in various cities. Crafting Recipes are required to be able to craft item types.
0.1.0.title: Version 1

0.1.1.description: Fix to avoid breaking manual and improve descriptions on skillsanity.
0.1.1.title: Fix to avoid breaking manual

0.2.0.description:
Some cleanup of stale items between sessions. 

SkillSanity is now based on attributes and focus to determine what skill you can reach. These will be granted by the archipelago. Currently this attribute/focus point logic will apply whether you have skillsanity on or not, so I would recommend you have it on.
0.2.0.title: Modified SkillSanity to use attributes/focus

0.3.0.description:
War sails is properly supported now, excluding tournaments. War sails skills and troops are part of the archipelago.

Bandit, minor factions, and mercenaries have been added. These are less tested, enable these at your own risk.

A few names were incorrect
0.3.0.title: New update, better DLC logic, war sails logic, fixes for troops

0.3.1.description: Craft sanity and skill sanity can be fully disabled now.
0.3.1.title: Add ability to fully disable skill/craft sanities
